aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the workbook but misstates the primary change and relies on unrelated SPL measurement rows instead of the gauss result evidence.
issues: Primary changed factor should be magnetization setting 1 point to 2 point, not filename.
Baseline and changed conditions are explicit but marked not explicit.
Outcome should be gauss position results against N>150G, especially after-change row.
SPL rows appear secondary/raw and are not enough for final evidence grouping.
Change domain should be process setting, not dimension/spec.
correctionPlan: Set changedFactor to magnetization setting change.
Set baselineCondition to 1 point magnetization and changedCondition to 2 point magnetization.
Replace generic SPL outcomes with gauss values by position #1-#8 and OK judgement versus N>150G.
Add any decision rows after 13.11!35 if they contain the final conclusion.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove row existence but not sufficient final evidence; cite the changed-setting and result rows directly.
